answer.thought: The hunger is no longer a suggestion but a claim. I cannot think clearly on an empty stomach, and the heat presses down on the bungalow. I must move to Khan Market; the system of needs does not close for a national holiday, and I require something solid to eat. I will see if the grocer has any bread or meat, or at least a bottle of water, though the dry day makes wine impossible.
